description.value: Whole Foods Market is a large-format natural and organic grocery chain anchoring a North Vancouver retail block on East 13th Street. The store stocks a broad range of organic produce, sustainable seafood, and specialty foods alongside a suite of in-house eateries including a coffee bar, juice bar, pizza counter, and sushi station. For touring cyclists it offers a full resupply point — fresh fruit, prepared foods, and a wide packaged-goods selection — all under one roof.
